A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DVD research and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete research appendices A–C. The removal of the NeurIPS checklist in v3 does not prevent comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original DVD experiments on domain adaptation, supervised classification, and domain generalization, together with ablations, runtime measurements, and seed-robustness results.

after.justification: v3 retains original DVD experimental results in Sections 4.1–4.5 and Appendices A–C, including benchmark performance, ablations, and robustness analyses.

M1.justification: The written method specification is corrected: Eq. 3 maximizes rather than minimizes cosine similarity, and Eq. 7 replaces an error indicator with softmax cross-entropy. These corrections match v1's existing prose; the DVD architecture, drift procedure, SiLGA, and DVD-CT remain unchanged, and an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same adaptation, classification, and generalization datasets. The appendix's open-set/partial-set evaluations and synthetic domain-shift scenarios were already present in v1; none are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the main and appendix tables, including transformer, runtime, and open-set/partial-set comparisons. The added Wang et al. (2024) citation does not introduce an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 changes the reported diffusion schedule from 8 to 16 steps. In Section 4.4, the sensitivity study's fixed source/target neighbor counts change from 5 to 15, while Figure 3(a)'s tested counts change from 3–7 to 5, 10, 15, 17, and 20. These are revisions to stated settings; rerunning experiments is not established.

E4.justification: The neighborhood-size sensitivity analysis in Section 4.4/Figure 3(a) is revised to report robustness over larger neighbor counts, retaining the plotted accuracy curves. The remaining component ablations, diffusion-schedule tests, synthetic-shift analyses, and initialization study are unchanged.

E5.justification: Removing checklist item 7 deletes the general statement that results summarize repeated experiments with different random seeds. Existing uncertainty displays, the five-run runtime protocol, and Appendix C.6's five-seed study remain unchanged; no change in actual run counts is established.

E6.justification: Figure 3(a) associates the same plotted accuracies with different neighbor counts, moving the reported peak from k=5 to k=15. All 22 tables retain their numerical values. This changes parameter–result associations without establishing a performance improvement under comparable settings.

T1.justification: Eq. 3 corrects the mathematical neighborhood definition from argmin to argmax of cosine similarity. Eq. 7 corrects the classification-loss formula from a misclassification indicator to negative log softmax probability. The remaining mathematical development, assumptions, and appendix graphical-model formulation are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about explicit source-free knowledge transfer, vicinity-guided diffusion, benchmark performance, source-domain augmentation, and domain generalization. Local wording refinements do not materially change their scope.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, interpretations of experimental results, privacy framing, and applicability boundaries are retained. Appendix C.5 already discusses closed-set limitations, negative transfer, and the remaining limitations of DVD-CT in v1.

D1.justification: v3 removes the repository link from the abstract and deletes checklist statements about supplementary implementation code and reproduction instructions. Reported diffusion and sensitivity settings are corrected, while hardware, optimizer, and other implementation disclosures remain largely unchanged. The PDFs do not establish that the repository itself became unavailable.

R1.justification: v3 adds Wang et al. (2024), concerning source-informed latent augmentation within neighborhood context, to the references and the contrastive-clustering discussion in Section 3.4. The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 removes the administrative NeurIPS checklist and makes limited wording, terminology, affiliation, and appendix-reference edits. The research narrative, section ordering, and substantive appendix organization remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3(a)'s horizontal-axis labels and legend are revised. Table 2 moves from page 8 to page 7, causing nearby text to reflow, and the Appendix heading is recentered. Other figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves mathematical correctness through Eqs. 3 and 7 and aligns the reported 16-step default with the existing appendix study in Table 12. These localized corrections improve internal consistency and implementability without strengthening the empirical evidence. Removing the code pointer and general seed disclosure weakens reproducibility documentation and limits the net improvement.
